name: Stumpy
notes: Persistent personal agents you text over Telegram, SMS, email or Slack, or chat with on the web: calendar, email triage, reminders, routines and scheduling, with webhooks and MCP for extension. Built by a solo founder, Preston Guillory. Freemium: free tier with one agent and a daily message cap, Personal $50/mo, Pro $200/mo, Enterprise custom. No iMessage or WhatsApp. Requested via the form (issue #343).
tagline: Persistent AI agents that show up in Telegram, texts and email
